landformBlockoutRules: Do not place an unbroken cliff, shoreline, or permanent landmark across any Growth Frontier or Expansion Corridor socket.
North Crown is the only clearly high district mass; Middle Belt is predominantly level; South Belt is lower and more open.
Water begins only in the South Belt and must not leak into Central Commons or become the identity of the middle city.
The HoloCa bypass splits after G-SOUTH and may rejoin south of HoloCa before the 1:2→1:3 seam.
Reserve parcels must read as ordinary gardens, yards, terraces, groves or promenades while empty; no blank construction pads.
Chunk boundaries are technical slices, not visible district borders.
Final terrain art must keep the adopted Layton-like muted storybook character and avoid dense AI-looking micro-detail.
